FN-5V7S7MM-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 425
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Mark Gidley
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/13/2026
House Bill 425 as introduced would decrease sales and use tax receipts to the Education Trust
Fund by approximately $32,000 annually, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027 and ending in Fiscal
Year 2029, based on information provided by the entity, by exempting Sleep in Heavenly Peace,
Inc., from paying state sales and use taxes.
This bill could also decrease sales and use tax receipts to counties and municipalities by
approximately $42,000 annually provided the respective local governments adopt an exemption
from local sales and use taxes, pursuant to this bill.
